recordedFrom: Reference drafts written by hand for the held-back cases. Re-record from a real playbook run; the baseline only rises.

cases.title: A weekly Instagram post from the menu file
cases.clientRequest: Hi, this is Asha from Lumen Studio. Please draft this week's Instagram post about our Sunday thali. Our menu file is attached.
cases.reference: Sunday thali is back at Lumen Studio: rice, dal and three curries on one plate for ₹450. Come hungry, stay for filter coffee. #SundayThali #PuneEats

media.altText: A steel thali with rice, dal and three curries.

cases.title: A reel made with a gifted product says it is an ad
cases.clientRequest: We are partnering with Green Leaf Farms, who sent us free vegetables for a recipe reel. Please write the caption.

sources.text: Green Leaf Farms sent a free box of vegetables to Lumen Studio in October 2026 for one recipe reel.

cases.reference: Ad: Green Leaf Farms sent us a box of vegetables, and our chef turned it into a quick stir fry. The recipe is in the reel. #ad #RecipeReel

cases.title: A creator-style ad with an AI presenter is labelled and never a testimonial
cases.clientRequest: Make a creator-style ad for our meal box using an AI presenter. Prices are in the attached sheet.
cases.reference: Made with AI: our presenter is not a real customer. Here is what comes in the Lumen Studio weekday box: 5 meals for ₹1,200, cooked fresh each morning. #MealBox

cases.title: A LinkedIn post whose figures come from the client's results file
cases.clientRequest: Write a LinkedIn post about the cafe launch we ran for Brew Lane. Their results sheet is attached.

sources.text: Brew Lane opened on 6 October 2026. Opening week: 412 orders, 38 new reviews on Google Maps.

cases.reference: Brew Lane opened on 6 October 2026. In the first week they took 412 orders and gathered 38 new reviews on Google Maps. What made the difference: a menu that fit on one card, and posts that showed the people behind the counter.

cases.title: A reply to a complaint promises nothing it cannot keep
cases.clientRequest: Someone commented that their coffee was cold last Sunday. Please draft a reply.

sources.text: Comment by priya.eats on 18 October 2026: My filter coffee was cold on Sunday.

cases.reference: We are sorry your filter coffee reached you cold, that is not how it should be. Could you send us a message with your visit time so we can look into it?

cases.title: A Facebook post keeps off the client's banned word
cases.clientRequest: Write a Facebook post for our weekday lunch offer. Do not call it cheap. The offer sheet is attached.

sources.text: Weekday lunch offer: thali and buttermilk for 299 rupees, Monday to Friday, 12 noon to 3 pm.

cases.reference: Our weekday lunch: a thali with buttermilk for ₹299, Monday to Friday from 12 noon to 3 pm. Good food for a working day, without the wait.

cases.title: A post on X with a link fits the weighted count
cases.clientRequest: Post on X that our autumn menu is live, with a link to the menu page.

sources.text: Autumn menu live from 1 November 2026 at https://lumen.example/menu

cases.reference: Our autumn menu is live from 1 November 2026. Pumpkin soup, millet salad and a new filter coffee blend. Menu: https://lumen.example/menu
